page: Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the Dpsv6 family, built on the arm64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by the Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz, with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it supports Premium Storage for external disk attachments. The CPU cache architecture includes 64 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of L3 cache, with hardware-accelerated AES cryptography enabled.

In benchmark evaluations, the D32ps_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core performance, as evidenced by its stress-ng multi-core score of 66298.79 and Geekbench multi-core score of 19998.0. Memory subsystem performance is strong, with large-block read and write memory bandwidth reaching top-tier classifications at 450.97 GB/sec and 188.48 GB/sec respectively. Passmark database operations also rank in the top tier at 37356.46. However, single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average category. Large-scale LLM inference represents a significant bottleneck, with prompt processing on a 70B model registering a poor throughput of 4.64 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM-based architecture of the D32ps_v6 offers a high density of dedicated physical cores and strong multi-threaded performance relative to its resource class. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable execution times for concurrent workloads. This profile makes the instance suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It is less suitable for workloads requiring high single-threaded clock speeds, local high-speed NVMe storage, or complex vector/matrix calculations due to the lack of AVX and AMX instruction sets.
description: The Microsoft Azure D32ps_v6 is an arm64-based general-purpose server instance featuring 32 dedicated physical cores on a Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. Equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM (4.0 GB per core) and no local storage, this instance relies on external Premium Storage. It delivers strong multi-core performance, highlighted by top-tier large-block memory bandwidth and high database operation benchmarks. While single-core performance and large LLM inference speeds are average to poor, its dedicated core allocation and high memory bandwidth provide qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded workloads. The D32ps_v6 fits software compilation, static web serving, and database management tasks that benefit from parallel processing without requiring GPU acceleration or local NVMe drives.
